item.title: US soldier arrested over Russia spy suspicion handed to US military
item.body: Counterterror police arrested the US army officer in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia. He has since been taken into custody by the US military. Police said they "will act swiftly and robustly" when espionage is suspected.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🕵️ US soldier arrested over Russia spy suspicion handed to US military

Counterterror police arrested the US army officer in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia. He has since been taken into custody by the US military. Police said they "will act swiftly and robustly" when espionage is suspected.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 17 November, 19:51
